title: Exam answers not saving
alert: exam-service autosave 409 session not found during semester finals; redis-exam used_memory 99%
root cause: semester finals used the shared Redis instead of the dedicated exam Redis
fix: Extended the exam window, raised redis-exam maxmemory, moved sessions to the dedicated Redis and replayed the autosave journal

title: Login OTPs delayed
alert: auth-service OTP delivery p95 4 minutes at exam start; learner phone 9900112233
root cause: A marketing notification blast used the same SMS route as login OTPs
fix: Moved OTPs to a dedicated transactional SMS route with email OTP as fallback

title: Fee payments stuck as pending
alert: fee-payments webhook signature verification failed; 2,300 payments pending
root cause: The payment gateway webhook secret was rotated but not updated in fee-payments
failed fixes: Asking learners to pay again (caused double charges)
fix: Updated the webhook secret, reconciled pending payments and refunded duplicates

title: Emails going to spam

fix: Restored the DKIM and SPF records and resent only to unopened recipients
